name: Ruincraft Corpskin Manifesto Jacket
description:
A Shelf-made oversized jacket assembled from weather-membrane scraps, transit seat vinyl, and deconstructed Ouroboros-brand workwear. Every panel is covered in hand-stenciled text — excerpts from the Meridian Labor Accord (crossed out), pirate-broadcast transcripts, and the phrase ΦUANTA IS A LIE repeated across the left shoulder in drip-paint red. Corporate logos appear inverted, stitched upside-down as deliberate mockery.

No two jackets are identical. The construction itself is the statement — visible seams, mismatched thread, patches over patches.
functionality: Weather-membrane panels provide moderate acid-rain resistance. Deep interior pockets are large enough for a compressed rebreather. Deliberately unfinished edges allow quick field modification.
what_it_says: This person rejects the system loudly, on purpose, and has the craft to make it beautiful.
story_hooks: A specific jacket contains a complete transcript of an internal Ouroboros memo about Shelf water contamination, hidden in the layered text.
CorpSec has begun cataloguing these jackets as gang-adjacent material — wearing one is now grounds for a stop-and-scan.
A Tier 5 fashion house has begun producing luxury replicas at Φ4,000 each, and the Shelf makers are furious.
